per_candidate.id: s2:Parametrized post-Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff framework for screened modified gra

rationale: Papers 2403.03399 and 2605.30369 directly investigate the nature of the 2.5 M_odot component in GW190814, exploring modified gravity and a nonmonotonic sound-speed equation of state as potential explanations. These contribute substantive new evidence but do not fully settle the question.
